requirements.name: Embedded DSP in C/C++
requirements.note: No C/C++ or embedded hardware work is described; the production programming work described (a Python data pipeline) is not embedded/real-time signal-processing code running on hardware.

lines.quote: built and maintain the automated data pipeline (Python 3.9, pandas, SQLAlchemy, Airflow) that ingests, processes, and archives radar test campaign data across Fenno’s product line; includes scheduled ETL jobs, automated PDF report generation, and anomaly alerting

operated Keysight PNA-X vector network analysers, R&S signal generators, spectrum analysers, and calibrated power sensors for radar front-end component characterisation; experienced with near-field antenna measurement setups and S-parameter extraction workflows

requirements.name: Relevant degree or demonstrated equivalent

lines.quote: Perform Doppler processing and clutter mitigation analysis for radar returns across varying precipitation and terrain conditions

requirements.note: Degree is in materials science, not electrical engineering, physics or applied mathematics; field-adjacency is a judgement call for the recruiter. Nine years of concrete professional signal-processing work (waveform design, pulse compression, Doppler processing) may evidence the requirement's alternative allowance for demonstrated equivalent competence without a directly relevant degree.

lines.quote: I have also had some exposure to satellite and airborne platform contexts through adjacent work at Fenno, though that has not been my primary focus.
All project communication, documentation, and technical reporting was conducted in English to accommodate the international research team.

ask_in_screening.question: Can you describe any hands-on experience you have with phased-array or beamforming signal-processing algorithms, if any?
Can you describe any experience you have writing embedded signal-processing software in C or C++ that runs on real hardware under real timing constraints, if any?
